title: Misdirection Goodwill Schedule for Mobile Wallet Transfers
content:
Goodwill schedule for **Mobile Wallet** money credited to the wrong wallet.

**Misdirection goodwill.** The days the money was misdirected are counted in calendar days to the date of the error-found decision, from the starting date of the misdirection period. The misdirection goodwill on a wrong-wallet funding follows those days:

| Days misdirected | Misdirection goodwill |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 2.0 percent |
| at least 4 and fewer than 7 | 1.0 percent |
| fewer than 4 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, decision dated 2026-04-20)

| Misdirection period starts | Days misdirected | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-17 | 3 | nothing |
| 2026-04-16 | 4 | 1.0 percent |
| 2026-04-14 | 6 | 1.0 percent |
| 2026-04-13 | 7 | 2.0 percent |
